name: Beaked Axe
description: Spear-section listing (distinct from the Pole Arms Beaked Axe row). Shorter, one-handed.

name: Nunchaku
description: Western table (Ball and Chain, p. 205) and oriental prose (p. 207). Can be used as a paired weapon for striking. Entangle only if one weapon is used with two hands.

genreStats.notes: Entangle requires using one nunchaku with two hands.

name: Bo Staff
description: Western table (p. 205) plus oriental prose (p. 206): size should be about a foot taller than the owner. Cost conflict: table $140 vs oriental $120 — table cost used; oriental $120 noted.

genreStats.damageSpecial: Damage is that of the short bow that fires them
Damage is that of the long bow that fires them
Damage is that of the crossbow that fires them

name: Aikuchi
description: Curved Japanese dagger without a hilt (Tanto has a hilt). Can be thrown. Cost varies by quality and beauty.

averageCost.notes: Varies according to quality and beauty.

name: Tanto
description: Curved Japanese dagger with a hilt (Aikuchi has no hilt). Can be thrown. Cost varies by quality and beauty.

averageCost.notes: Varies according to quality and beauty.

name: Bisento
description: Spear with a broad, curved blade, large enough to be considered a kind of pole arm. Must be imported from Japan.

name: Blow Gun
description: Favorite ninja weapon. Effective range is no more than 50 ft.

genreStats.damageSpecial: The dart itself does no damage
genreStats.payloadNotes: Usually coated with poison or drugs (GM-resolved).

name: Ninja Bow
description: Short, none too powerful bow favored by ninjas; can be disassembled and easily hidden.

name: Samurai Long Bow
description: Separate skill learned by the ninja; probably the most powerful weapon of its type in the world.

averageCost.notes: $1,000 or more for a high quality samurai bow.

name: Modern Hunting Bow
description: Modern commercial hunting bow listed with ancient oriental bows (Nightbane RPG).

name: Heavy Crossbow
description: Heavy, two-handed crossbow. Commonly available by mail order in the U.S.

name: Pistol Crossbow
description: 40 lb, pistol-style crossbow. Commonly available by mail order in the U.S.

name: Daisho
description: Literally "the long and the short" — traditional Japanese set of one long sword (Katana) and one short sword (Wakizashi). Listed under both Large Swords and Short Swords. Using both together is a separate skill (paired weapons).

genreStats.damageSpecial: When used as paired weapons: 1D8+2 (long / Katana), 1D6 (short / Wakizashi)
genreStats.notes: Component weapons retain their own qualityVariants for solo use. Set cost for fair vs authentic paired use printed as little as $150 / $1,200. Daisho is one long (Katana) and one short (Wakizashi) sword; catalog category lists both large_swords and short_swords.

averageCost.notes: As little as $150 for fair quality and $1,200 for an authentic high quality (paired set pricing from Daisho / paired-use text).

name: Jitte
description: Oversized three-pronged fork, generally designed to be used as a pair (with Sai). Excellent for countering samurai sword attacks; skilled user can entangle with one hand and attack with the other.

name: Sai
description: Oversized three-pronged fork, generally designed to be used as a pair (with Jitte). Excellent for countering samurai sword attacks; skilled user can entangle with one hand and attack with the other.

name: Katana
description: Primary weapon of the Samurai warrior; a long sword up to 3 ft in length. Enormous difference in quality between manufactured and authentic blades.

averageCost.notes: Manufactured versions could be as little as $300.
A top quality sword could cost at least $5,000.

name: Kusari-Gama
description: Chain with a weight on one end and a sickle on the other. One end can entangle while the other strikes. Ninja favorite; also used as a climbing device.

name: Kyoketsu-Shogi
description: Made with rope; iron ring on one end and a double blade on the other. Somewhat less damaging than Kusari-Gama. One end can entangle while the other strikes; usually used as a climbing device.

name: Kawanga
description: Ninja combination of a rope and grapple used for climbing and fighting. Separate chain weapon.

name: Manriki-Gusari
description: Chain with solid blunt weights on each end. Can entangle with one end and strike with the other. Easy to disassemble and conceal; can be improvised from hardware-store chain and lead weights.

name: No-Dachi
description: Huge two-handed sword; 5 to 6 ft long, carried on the back and drawn over the shoulder. Does much more damage than most weapons in its class.

name: Sa Tjat Koen
description: Malaysian weapon that looks like Nunchaku with a second chain and third handle. Can entangle like nunchaku. Cannot be used as a paired weapon.

name: Shikomi-Zue
description: Hollow bamboo staff with a concealed spring-loaded blade (release via trigger stud). Ninja commonly disguised themselves as blind men while carrying it. Usable as a somewhat fragile Bo Staff or as a spear.

genreStats.notes: Dual mode: Bo Staff or spear. Object S.D.C. 50 (fragile staff).

name: Shuriken
description: Ninja throwing stars — designed more for concealment and discouraging pursuit than raw lethality. Throwing knives require a different technique.

name: Throwing Knife (Oriental)
description: Listed with Shuriken pricing (Nightbane RPG). Throwing knives require a different technique than shuriken.

genreStats.notes: Damage not separately listed from shuriken (1D4); encoded to match the shared damage line on that entry.

name: Naginata
description: Curved-blade spear. Otherwise alike to Yari and used as a spear. Very difficult to conceal.

name: Yari
description: Straight-blade spear. Otherwise alike to Naginata and used as a spear. Very difficult to conceal.

name: Wakizashi
description: Short sword favored by the samurai. The ninja short sword has a straighter blade but is otherwise just like a wakizashi. Cost varies by quality (see Katana).

averageCost.notes: Cost varies according to quality — see Katana prices.
Cost varies according to quality — see Katana prices.

name: Tonfa
description: Short wood weapon ideal for parrying and close combat.
